what: From integrate-tooling (01073 item 5, what the tooling pass could not port without v2 features): three CI-row harnesses test v1 settings no v2 crate reads, so they fail against v2 as written and will be red in the train. testselect.py sets BLAZE_TESTS=affected/all (v2's form is `blaze test --reached`, crates/blaze-cargo/src/cli/args.rs: port it to that, or say what --reached lacks); hermetic.py runs `blaze test --why --json` and reads target/blaze/tests.ndjson (v2 has neither: a v2 feature, cargo lane, before the harness can port); loadedits.py holds a load with BLAZE_LOAD_PAUSE_MS (needs a v2 hook in the VFS load, vfs lane). Not in CI, same cause: sandboxbench.py and testselectbench.py (BLAZE_TESTS), spare.py and memsplit.py (v1's spare worker, BLAZE_SPARE). Each needs an owner to decide: port onto what v2 has, add the v2 feature, or delete the harness with its row. fncache/bscache/frozenwarm/freshwarm were already deleted.
